notes.title: Catch us in Wholesome Games Celebration on Steam!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello gourdies,[/p][p][/p][p]Just dropping by to let you know Gourdlets and Gourdlets Together are in the Wholesome Celebration on Steam, with Gourdlets on sale at 25% off! I’m super excited to be included in this lovely event as I’m such a big fan of wholesome and all they do! The celebration is running from now until the 14th, so be sure to check it out! 💜[/p][p][/p][p]Hope you’ve all been having great summers  - I’ve also been taking some much-needed time to vacation and see family, which has been amazing! Stay tuned for more Gourdlets related news soon 🌞

notes.title: Gourdlets Together is here!!
notes.notes:
[p]Gourd day,[/p][p][/p][p]Did ya miss me? Because I missed you!
[/p][p]If you’re new to the gourd family, hi 👋 I’m Preethi, and last year I launched my debut game Gourdlets, an easygoing sandbox game about building towns for cute vegetable folks. After many requests for a multiplayer version and seeing the lovely community that was growing in the games discord, I decided to create [b]Gourdlets Together[/b]! We announced the news today in Wholesome Direct, you can watch the trailer below:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="9eVmtDz_Yn4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]But don’t worry, you don’t have to know Gourdlets to love Gourdlets Together! This is very much a standalone game that everyone can enjoy. [/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what you can expect from Gourdlets Together:[/p][p]🏠 Cozy island building: unlimited building to create your dream gourd home! [/p][p]💬Multiplayer: visit your friends’ islands, build together, and have a lil catch up in the chat feature while you’re there! [/p][p]🎣Fishing mode: Catch fish to level up your fishing gear and earn money for special items and accessories! [/p][p] [/p][p]Well I hope you’re as excited as I am, stay tuned for more updates and in the meantime make sure to wishlist the games and follow for more gourd content![/p][list][*][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@aunty__games"][u]Tiktok[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.threads.net/@auntygames?xmt=AQGzhFeesrkp3TRTTq5wOTCMf5T3hPi2XzY5-iyezhIeaJY"][u]Threads[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/auntygames.bsky.social"][u]Bluesky[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://twitter.com/AuntyGames"][u]Twitter/ X[/u][/url] [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Talk soon,[/p][p]Preethi 💜[/p]
